summary: Silent 20 s POV meme ad for personalized book-lover crew socks: one persistent joke caption over seven quick lifestyle shots that keep revealing the personalized sole (cartoon avatar + name AMELIA, 'SHHH... I'M READING').
format: POV meme caption + product showcase montage (no voiceover, no end card)

hook.text: POV: You tried talking to her mid chapter 💀
hook.description: Woman reading on a couch lifts one foot toward the camera at about 1 s, revealing the sole message 'SHHH... I'M READING' as the punchline to the POV caption.

scenes.setting: cozy living room, grey couch, bookshelf, plants
scenes.description: Woman reading a novel on the couch; at about 1 s she raises her foot so the sole fills the frame.

scenes.setting: bed with knit blanket, warm lamp light
scenes.description: Smiling woman reading in bed with both soles toward the camera: left sole shows a cartoon avatar and the name AMELIA, right sole the 'SHHH... I'M READING' message.
Hands pull the socks up the calves, showing the all-over pattern of book stacks, glasses, teacups and snowdrop flowers.
Woman with glasses reads an open book with both soles toward the camera, repeating the avatar + name and message.

scenes.setting: kraft gift box with white tissue paper
scenes.description: Hands open tissue paper inside a kraft box to reveal the folded socks, soles up.
Woman sits on the carpet taking a phone selfie in a mirror with the socks in the foreground.

scenes.setting: bed with cream sheets and a patterned quilt
scenes.description: Pair laid flat side by side showing the full design: pattern on top, avatar + AMELIA and the message on the soles.

on_screen_text.text: POV: You tried talking to her mid chapter 💀
on_screen_text.style: white bold sans, black outline, two lines, centred

personalization_elements: custom cartoon avatar matching the buyer (hair colour, outfit)

people.description: several different young women with long blonde hair, casual cozy outfits (sweaters, lounge wear)

style.look: authentic UGC, phone-shot, natural home settings
style.lighting: soft daylight from windows; warm lamp light in scene 2
style.color_palette: sage and dark green product against cream, beige and wood tones
style.pacing: 7 shots in 20 s, average about 2.8 s per shot, hard cuts
style.audio: no audio track in the file

do_not_copy: TikTok app interface captured in the recording (account row, caption bar, 'See more', search icon)
the other seller's brand and account name 'Gift Soul'
the exact sole artwork and the example name AMELIA: replace with the client's own product and personalization
replication_notes: Keep the POV joke caption structure but write it for the client's product and audience.
Every shot must show the personalized area (name/photo/avatar) within the first second of the shot.
Mix shot types in this order: hook reveal, personalization close-up, pattern detail, lifestyle, unboxing, selfie, flat-lay hero.
The sample has no CTA or price: the replica should add an end card with price and CTA (client requirement) after the montage.
Use Seedance 2.5 with each scene as one 3 s clip at 9:16, or the whole sample as @Video1 in edit mode (needs the public HTTPS URL, 4-30 s).
